svg.title: The reset of Z4 under five control systems
svg.desc: Five timelines of the active reset of Z4, one per control system. In each, a pi pulse is followed by a readout from 40 to 240 ns, and a second pi pulse that is sent only if the readout read 1. one controller, 100 ns feedback: the flip starts at 340 ns, after 100 ns of feedback latency, and the reset ends at 380 ns; one controller, 400 ns feedback: the flip starts at 640 ns, after 400 ns of feedback latency, and the reset ends at 680 ns; a controller per feedline: the flip starts at 340 ns, after 100 ns of feedback latency, and the reset ends at 380 ns; drive and readout modules: the flip starts at 540 ns, after 100 ns of feedback latency and 200 ns between controllers, and the reset ends at 580 ns; six drive lanes: the flip starts at 340 ns, after 100 ns of feedback latency, and the reset ends at 380 ns.
